A location left below zero stays here until a stock count is recorded there or a later entry brings it back to zero or more: a goods receipt, a transfer in, a return against its issue or repair, or an entry with its reason.

dialog.title: Record a stock count
dialog.description: {{article}} at {{location}} stands at {{onHand}} on this PC. Count what is physically there: within the four-eyes tolerance the stock becomes the counted quantity and the item closes; above it, the count waits for a second person's approval and moves nothing until then. The count is recorded like any count and audited.
dialog.reasonPlaceholder: At least {{count}} characters: what was found and why

doubleCount.explain: Counted on two PCs, neither knowing the other: each corrected the stock, so it may be corrected twice (now {{onHand}} on hand). Check the stock and record a new count.
doubleCount.closedByReversal: closed by the reversal of count {{session}} ({{who}}, {{date}})

doublePosting.movementLine: {{who}}, {{date}}: {{quantity}} (the stock ledger does not record the PC)

posted_twice.COUNT_ADJUST: Count {{session}} was posted to stock more than once (the same count on two PCs, older version): beyond the count's correction of {{variance}}, the stock moved {{excess}} more (now {{onHand}} on hand). Check the stock and record a new count.
posted_twice.COUNT_REVERSAL: The reversal of count {{session}} was posted more than once (on two PCs, older version): beyond the reversal of {{variance}}, the stock moved {{excess}} more (now {{onHand}} on hand). Check the stock and record a new count.

divergent.COUNT_ADJUST: Count {{session}} was posted on two PCs with different quantities: the version that reached the server first ({{variance}}) is kept on every PC and the stock follows it; the other differed by {{excess}} (now {{onHand}} on hand). Its count line is a sync conflict on the PC whose version was replaced. Check the stock and record a new count.
divergent.COUNT_REVERSAL: The reversal of count {{session}} was posted on two PCs with different quantities: the version that reached the server first ({{variance}}) is kept on every PC and the stock follows it; the other differed by {{excess}} (now {{onHand}} on hand). Check the stock and record a new count.

explainKind.over_issue: {{document}}: {{expected}} reserved, {{actual}} issued in all (issues made on several PCs, returns deducted), {{excess}} too many. {{onHand}} on hand now. Check the stock and record a count on a PC that has received all these issues.
explainKind.over_receipt: Purchase order {{document}}: {{expected}} ordered, {{actual}} received in all (receipts made on several PCs), {{excess}} too many. {{onHand}} on hand now. Check the stock and record a count on a PC that has received all these receipts.
